question:
The Pie chart shows the percentage distributions of total number of laptops (both Dell and HP) sold by six stores in March.

Refer to the pie chart and table carefully and answer the given questions.

Total number = 11200

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/311fddfe2acc296196913f593610a05fdc0edd29aeb4afbf450093a4ec41e8c4.png] 

Ratio of the numbers of Dell and HP sold

 
 

 **Stores **
 Ratio&nbs
solution:
**Calculation:**

The number of Dell laptops sold by store B is 11200 × 26/100 × 7/13 = 1568

HP laptops sold by stores E and F together 11200 × 14/100 × 3/7 + 11200 × 10/100 × 1/4 =952

Difference is 1568 - 952 = 616

The percentage is 616/952 × 100 = 64.70%
